# Access Control and Password Policy

## Purpose
This SOP governs authentication, password rules, and periodic access review for
all company systems.

## Password Requirements
- Minimum password length: 12 characters, including at least one number and one
  special character.
- Passwords must be rotated every 90 days.
- Password reuse is blocked for the last 10 passwords.

## Account Lockout
- Accounts are locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
- Lockout duration is 30 minutes, after which the account automatically unlocks.

## Multi-Factor Authentication
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for all privileged and
administrator accounts. Standard user accounts must enable MFA within 30 days
of account creation.

## Access Review
The Security Team reviews all user access rights quarterly. Any access not
justified by current role requirements must be revoked within 5 business days
of the review.
